messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service gpu-infer-west2 (pd/INV001234). Auto-pager invoked — reason: NVML OOM spikes across pool 'infer-west2a'. Samples: 8 OOMs in 60s. Link: https://pd.example/incidents/INV001234
alice_oncall: acked via PD. I'm jumping on it. Checking allocations and recent deploys.
bob_sre: looking at node metrics — GPU mem usage at 98% on nodes g-node-17/18, eviction rate spike. nvml log snippet:
```[2026-03-17T00:12:03Z] NVML: CudaError: out of memory (cudaErrorMemoryAllocation) pid=4321 ctx=0x7f
gpu0: fbUsed=24576MiB fbTotal=24576MiB
```
carla_engineer: any recent model rollouts? Can we route traffic to a smaller model variant and enable CPU fallback for embeddings?
dave_support: received chat from customer "acme-corp" about increased 503s on embeddings endpoint.
alice_oncall: rolling canary back? No recent deploys in past 2 hours. Might be prefetch/backfill job. Bob, can you list recent batch jobs? 
bob_sre: confirmed a scheduled nightly prefetch job overlapped with peak. Preemptively scaling up dedicated pool and triggering k/v cache eviction. Starting cordon+drain on g-node-18. 
carla_engineer: patch ready: disable prefetch for infer-west2 for 10m and lower batch sizes. Pushing now.
incident-bot: action: autoscaler triggered +2 gpus in pool 'infer-west2' (reason: manual scale). 
alice_oncall: PD note: ack + investigating, will escalate to SRE if not stable in 10m.
dave_support: updated customer with ETA 15m, told them we're mitigating and will follow up.
bob_sre: applied eviction, rerouted 30% traffic to cpu-fallback group, prefetch job paused. Memory usage dropping: nodes at 65-70% now.
carla_engineer: monitoring latency — token throughput stable, slight latency bump +60ms on fallback. 
alice_oncall: any sign of kernel or driver faults? 
bob_sre: no GPU driver resets seen. Kernel logs show occasional cuda launch failures but recoveries. Will keep watch.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: pd/INV001234 updated: status=investigating assignee=alice_oncall
alice_oncall: marking for handoff to day oncall at 07:00. If stable by 06:55 I'll resolve.
dave_support: keeping customer comms open. Noting impacted endpoints: /v1/embeddings, /v1/generate (low percentage).
bob_sre: preparing post-incident notes: probable cause = concurrent prefetch + high-concurrency inference causing KV cache amplification. Followups: add isolation for prefetch jobs, enforce pool quotas, improve autoscaler thresholds.
alice_oncall: thanks everyone. I'll leave the thread open and update final before resolving. :thumbsup:
carla_engineer: adding a short-term alert suppression rule for this signal to avoid noisy paging during manual mitigations (30m).
incident-bot: PagerDuty: pd/INV001234 acknowledged by alice_oncall at 1712348892
alice_oncall: last check 06:52 — system stable, evictions completed, autoscaler normalized. Closing in 10m unless regressions.
bob_sre: uploading small trace and nvml snippets to the incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INV001234
alice_oncall: resolved — root cause and mitigations will be summarized in the postmortem. Good job team. :tada:
